motions.description: Approve the consent agenda items including minutes, finance committee recommendations, bills and vouchers for January 2025, license applications, and several ordinances.

Receive and file a recommendation to approve a text amendment application amending Section 1408 of the Elmwood Park Zoning Code submitted by Marissa Massey, Secretary of the Plan, Zoning and Development Commission.
Approve the Village President's Trustee appointments as listed, including appointed positions, liaisons, and committee assignments.
Advise and consent to the Village President's appointments including James Parenti to the Police Pension Board and Fire Pension Board and WSSRA Board representatives.
Approve an Ordinance Amending Subsection 1408.01 of the Zoning Ordinance of the Village of Elmwood Park regarding Off-Street Parking Requirements in Certain B-1 Districts.
Approve a recommendation from the Traffic and Safety Commission to install Stop signs east and west bound Cortland Street at 75th Ct.
